root_cause_evidence: The highWaterMark is updated whenever a user deposits, withdraws, or mints.
exploitation_evidence: The inability to properly track the progress of earnings makes it impossible for the agreement to correctly charge for earnings when they are available.
fix_strategy_evidence: Adjust the highWaterMark update timing to occur only during initial deposits and after successful fee collections.

root_cause_evidence: The syncVaderPrice function does not update previousPrices after synchronizing prices.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker uses the lagged previousPrices to calculate the liquidity assessment and manipulate the liquidity share.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update the previousPrices array after price synchronization.

root_cause_evidence: Call syncGlobalCollateral() at the end of stabilize().
exploitation_evidence: Using an outdated collateralRatio for stabilization calculations can make stabilization operations inaccurate and may cause tokens to depeg.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call impliedCollateralService() before stabilize() executes.

root_cause_evidence: The deducted transaction fees (feesCollected - externalFee) are not added to totalFunds after calculating net transaction fees.
exploitation_evidence: The totalFunds calculation error affects the available funds in the liquidity pool, causing liquidity providers to lose part of their funds.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add the net collected transaction fees to totalFunds in the openShort() function.

root_cause_evidence: The actionLockedBalances[payer] is not updated for the payer when transferring stakes.
exploitation_evidence: stakedAndActionLockedBalanceOf() calculates wrong balance
fix_strategy_evidence: Call stakerVault.increaseActionLockedBalance to update after transferring funds.

root_cause_evidence: Reset the user's pendingFlashDecision to default configuration when processing pending governance decisions.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker repeatedly calls withdrawGovernanceAsset to steal funds.
fix_strategy_evidence: Properly clear the user's pendingFlashDecision state in the burnFlashGovernanceAsset() function.

root_cause_evidence: Different hash values corresponding to different orders are lacking.
exploitation_evidence: Creating multiple similar partially filled orders results in the same order hash value, which allows the partial asset to be locked.
fix_strategy_evidence: Introduce a random number (nonce) for each order to ensure that the orderHash is unique.

root_cause_evidence: totalWethDelegated is not reduced when users withdraw WETH.
exploitation_evidence: Reducing WETH reserves incorrectly resulted in a rollback due to insufficient reserves when attempting to restore the price.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update totalWethDelegated in the withdraw function.

root_cause_evidence: The syncRewards() function is not called to synchronize rewards before executing withdrawal operations.
exploitation_evidence: An accounting logic error caused the nextRewards calculation to be inflated, resulting in overpayment of rewards.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call syncRewards() before calling beforeWithdraw().

root_cause_evidence: The _sendToDistributor() function early returns if amount == 0.
exploitation_evidence: The cumulative APR was not calculated correctly, affecting the target APR calculation in updateDesiredAPR().
fix_strategy_evidence: Add conditions and modify the logic in _sendToDistributor() to update the current epoch's cumulative APR with the previous epoch's APR value when the amount is zero.

root_cause_evidence: The propose() function overwrites the hash of the currently active proposal.
exploitation_evidence: When an activated proposal is executed while a new proposal is pending, funds are permanently stuck in the contract.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add an orderHash field to the Listing struct to ensure active and new proposals maintain distinct hash values.

root_cause_evidence: The cleanupLoan() function is called before _updateAndCheckCollateral().
exploitation_evidence: A reentry attack is utilized to update debt shares multiple times, manipulate borrowing caps, and prevent other users from borrowing.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call cleanupLoan() after _updateAndCheckCollateral().

root_cause_evidence: Update accumulated rewards only during trades, not transfers.
exploitation_evidence: The fee offset for the new account was not updated, resulting in incorrect calculation of the fees due to the account.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call onBalanceChange() to update accumulated rewards in all balance-changing operations.

root_cause_evidence: The depositTime of the target position is set directly to the depositTime of the source position.
exploitation_evidence: If the bankruptcy time of the target bucket is greater than the deposit time of the source location, the liquidity provider's funds will be permanently frozen.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update the depositTime of the target position to the latest valid deposit time of that position.

root_cause_evidence: The idleETH is not incremented when returning ETH.
exploitation_evidence: The idleETH is not increased correctly, allowing the attacker to call the bringUnusedETHBackIntoGiantPool() function to steal ETH.
fix_strategy_evidence: Increment the idleETH value accordingly in the bringUnusedETHBackIntoGiantPool() function.

root_cause_evidence: A Boolean flag indicating whether the funds have been withdrawn is missing.
exploitation_evidence: The withdrawCapital() function can be called multiple times until all remaining capital in the contract is withdrawn.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add a Boolean flag tokensWithdrawn to indicate whether funds have been withdrawn.

root_cause_evidence: Calculate the allocation ratio for each faction's NFTs based on the current totalVotingPower.
exploitation_evidence: The users’ allocation shares were miscalculated, allowing the attacker to obtain more funds than they deserved by destroying NFTs.
fix_strategy_evidence: Do not use dynamic totalVotingPower for allocation. Instead, record the initial totalVotingPower at the time of each distribution.

root_cause_evidence: The _setKeyManagerOf function does not clear single-token approvals.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker repeatedly transfers the key back to themselves from the victim without clearing the previous approval after the key transfer.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call the _clearApproval function to clear the approval.

root_cause_evidence: A type field is missing in the signature to distinguish different operation types.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker used the signature of refinanceFull() to prepend addNewTranche(), causing the loan amount to be approximately twice the original amount.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add a type field in the RenegotiationOffer to distinguish different operation types.

root_cause_evidence: Send the referral commission before updating state variables (totalClaimed, totalLicenses).
exploitation_evidence: The attacker used a reentrancy attack to purchase quantities exceeding the permitted limit.
fix_strategy_evidence: Process referral commission transfers after updating state variables (totalClaimed, totalLicenses).

root_cause_evidence: When _dontMint is true, the function immediately returns without incrementing the user's creditsOf balance.
exploitation_evidence: The user's payment amount was not correctly added to the credit balance, resulting in lost funds.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add an update to creditsOf[_data.beneficiary] before the return statement.

root_cause_evidence: beforeTokenTransfer() is called before the ETH transfer occurs.
exploitation_evidence: After receiving ETH, the attacker used the unlocked claimRewards() function to perform multiple transactions, resulting in too many rewards being issued.
fix_strategy_evidence: Perform the "idleETH -= _amount;" operation after burning the LP tokens.

root_cause_evidence: The oracle Pumps is not updated promptly.
exploitation_evidence: Manipulate the reserves of the current block and thus tamper with the prophecy machine data.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update the Pumps data immediately after each reserve change.

root_cause_evidence: ps.tokenBalances[] is not updated in the safeTransfer() function.
exploitation_evidence: The actual amount received returned to users when withdrawing or transferring funds is incorrect.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call transferOut() in claimFundingFees() to update token balances during fund transfers.

root_cause_evidence: Claim rewards when the TWAP falls below the protocol's price threshold.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker received two defaultIncentive rewards through flash loans in two consecutive blocks.
fix_strategy_evidence: Adjust the reward distribution conditions by adding a cooldown period.

root_cause_evidence: When reducing positions, the amount affecting the pool is incorrectly increased.
exploitation_evidence: The withdrawal amounts were not properly accounted for, falsely increasing the amounts affecting the pool.
fix_strategy_evidence: Check whether the user's withdrawn funds are sufficient before updating the affected pool.

root_cause_evidence: The recoverTimelock is not updated with each lottery draw.
exploitation_evidence: Administrators can bypass the waiting time limit by repeatedly calling lastResortTimelockOwnerClaimNFT() without waiting for the specified time lock period to expire.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update recoverTimelock with every lottery draw.

root_cause_evidence: A variable for tracking the current period number is missing.
exploitation_evidence: max_buy was miscalculated, causing users to incorrectly buy the next period's worth of bonds at a lower price than expected.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add a variable "currentEpoch" to track the current cycle number.

root_cause_evidence: The user's message field is overwritten with an empty string.
exploitation_evidence: The target contract cannot be called, which makes the cross-chain message function unable to work properly.
fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the message field as specified by the user.

root_cause_evidence: In the initLPP function, the LPPMetadata data structure is not initialized.
exploitation_evidence: Repeatedly calling the initLPP() function modifies the claimedSize and partOffset of LPP, resulting in incorrect state hashing.
fix_strategy_evidence: Remove unnecessary storage reads in the initLPP function. Additionally, add a check in the squeezeLPP function to ensure that bytesProcessed must be equal to claimedSize.

root_cause_evidence: The location of the _fillInEpochGaps() call is incorrect.
exploitation_evidence: fillInEpochGaps() did not correctly calculate and request rewards from overflowPool, resulting in lost rewards for unprofitable epochs.
fix_strategy_evidence: Remove the call to fillInEpochGaps(). Or, move the call to checkRewardUnderflow() to the beginning of each new epoch. Or, restrict calls to fillInEpochGaps() to administrators only.

root_cause_evidence: The liquidation() and rigidRedemption() functions calculate collateralRatio differently.
exploitation_evidence: Bypass the correct mortgage rate calculation by calculating only the principal amount borrowed and ignoring the share of the borrowing and accumulated fees.
fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the collateralRatio calculation method in the rigidRedemption() function.

root_cause_evidence: The maximum AVAX allocation per node in the cycle is increased via the increaseAVAXAssignedHighWater() function, rather than being directly updated to the current AVAXAssigned value.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker manipulates AVAX higher than the actual allocation to obtain more rewards.
fix_strategy_evidence: Change the previous cumulative update method to directly update to the current AVAXAssigned value.

root_cause_evidence: The tokenPrecisionMultipliers used in price calculations is not computed in real-time.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker use old tokenPrecision Multipliers for transactions before the target price takes effect.
fix_strategy_evidence: Change tokenPrecisionMultipliers to real-time calculation.

root_cause_evidence: The current allowance is not decremented based on existing withdrawal records.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker can front-run the approval change process to withdraw the previously approved funds early.
fix_strategy_evidence: Decrement the current allowance based on existing withdrawal records when setting a new allowance.

root_cause_evidence: The variable idleETH is not synchronized.
exploitation_evidence: An error in the calculation of idleETH caused ETH withdrawn from the vault to be permanently locked in the Giant Pool.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add an update for idleETH.

root_cause_evidence: After the purchase order is matched, when the ERC quantity is lower than the defined minimum value, the order will not be added to the market for initialization.
exploitation_evidence: A partially filled short record has no associated short order, which makes it impossible for the user to exit the short position or perform liquidation operations.
fix_strategy_evidence: After the call of matchIncomingSell(), make the Short Record reach the fully filled (SR.FullyFilled) state.

root_cause_evidence: The variable limiting user purchase quantity is not updated after license purchase.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker calls the claimLicensePartner() or claimLicensePublic() functions multiple times to repeatedly purchase licenses without restriction.
fix_strategy_evidence: Accurately record each user's purchase quantity to prevent overbuying.

root_cause_evidence: The variable for interest calculation remains unupdated during buyout operations.
exploitation_evidence: The slope of the new lien tokens is not added to the total slope of the public vault, borrowers are not paid interest, and liquidity providers cannot receive rewards.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add the new lien slope back to the total slope after buyout completion.

root_cause_evidence: Call previewDeposit() before updateFunding().
exploitation_evidence: The value of the assets calculated at the time of redemption included additional funds for an undeserved profit.
fix_strategy_evidence: Move the updateFunding() call to before previewDeposit().

root_cause_evidence: Update pendingBalances only after new proposal creation.
exploitation_evidence: The old proposer loses the deposit, and the new proposer can repeat the proposal.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update pendingBalances before calling _setListing().

root_cause_evidence: expressReceiveTokenWithData() delays state updates until after token transfers.
exploitation_evidence: Stealing funds in cross-chain transfers using reentry attacks.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call _setExpressReceiveTokenWithData() in advance.

root_cause_evidence: The time lock mechanism did not take effect as expected, allowing users to bypass the time lock and withdraw funds directly.
exploitation_evidence: The withdrawWithTimelockFrom() function sets incorrect _unlockTimestamps.
fix_strategy_evidence: The withdrawWithTimelockFrom() function should increment the unlock timestamp by the specified duration.

root_cause_evidence: There is a lack of a list of processed tokens to ensure that the same generation of tokens will not be counted multiple times.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker repeatedly calculated the balance of Token B, inflated the total assets, and then obtained more shares at a low price.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add deduplication logic in the oracleExit() function to ensure that the same generation of coins is not calculated multiple times.

root_cause_evidence: The calculation of variables like long0Fees and long1Fees is executed only after the transferFees() function call.
exploitation_evidence: The incorrect calculation of the long0Fees, long1Fees and other variables used to calculate fees caused the transfer fee to always be zero.
fix_strategy_evidence: Calculate the actual values of long0Fees, long1Fees, and shortFees before calling transferFees().

root_cause_evidence: The fee withdrawal status is not updated.
exploitation_evidence: The withdrawFee() function does not have any protection mechanism, allowing the protocol fee to be withdrawn multiple times.
fix_strategy_evidence: Track the protocol fee withdrawal status.

root_cause_evidence: There is a lack of mapping to avoid repeatedly depositing the same token.
exploitation_evidence: Multiple deposits of the same token resulted in duplicate token records in the account. holdingTokens array.
fix_strategy_evidence: Set the holdsToken map in addHolding() to distinguish different tokens.

root_cause_evidence: toiletState[tokenId].plotId is not updated when users transfer tokens to another plot.
exploitation_evidence: Allowing multiple tenants to occupy the same plot and causing errors in reward calculations.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update toiletState[tokenId].plotId in the transferToUnoccupiedPlot() function.

root_cause_evidence: There is a lack of a flag for indicating that the purchase operation of the contract is underway.
exploitation_evidence: onERC721Received() creates two pledge rights in the intermediate state, resulting in the same NFT being bound to two different pledge rights.
fix_strategy_evidence: Set a _marketBuyFlow flag to indicate that the contract is conducting a market purchase operation.

root_cause_evidence: lastClaimTotalRewards only updates when feeClaimable is greater than 0.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker transferred the balances of the two tokenIds and stole the rewards from the contract multiple times by repeatedly claiming the rewards.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update the variables lastClaimTotalRewards and timeClaimed before the feeClaimable check.

root_cause_evidence: In the constructor, only the 0th Generation (Generation 0) is initialized as 3, while subsequent generations (Generation 1, Generation 2, etc.) are not initialized.
exploitation_evidence: The mapping is uninitialized, resulting in a rollback of the calculation with a divide-by-zero error.
fix_strategy_evidence: Logic should be added to the contract to allow administrators to correctly initialize or update the numElements map each time a new generation is created.

root_cause_evidence: The profit distribution ratio is calculated before updating the dependent values.
exploitation_evidence: Using inaccurate values ​​when allocating profits leads to incorrect profit distribution, causing LPs (liquidity providers) to receive too much profit.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call syncGlobalCollateral() before calling handleProfit().

root_cause_evidence: The NFT post-liquidation state is not fully reset.
exploitation_evidence: The NFT cannot be unlocked successfully, which in turn affects the subsequent NFT extraction operations.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update tokenData.lockerAddr to address(0) during liquidation.

root_cause_evidence: The state variable totalLpETH is not locked to equal totalSupply.
exploitation_evidence: Pre- and post-operations (sandwich attack) to donate ETH and directly obtain lpETH.
fix_strategy_evidence: Limit the claimedAmount calculation to only the ETH amount obtained from LRT swaps.

root_cause_evidence: Reserves updates precede TWAP updates.
exploitation_evidence: Manipulate reserve values prior to TWAP updates, manipulate prices and profit on subsequent trades.
fix_strategy_evidence: Advance the execution position of the _twapUpdate() function.

root_cause_evidence: pointsSum.slope is not updated when nominees are removed.
exploitation_evidence: The slope for the removed nominees is still included in the calculation, resulting in an inaccurate calculation of the voting weight.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update pointsSum.slope in removeNominee().

root_cause_evidence: The update to totalCollateralReturned is missing.
exploitation_evidence: Liquidators burn excessive powerPerp tokens, resulting in a loss of funds.
fix_strategy_evidence: Calculate the token amount corresponding to the collateral actually received by the liquidator, then match the burned token quantity with the liquidator's actual received collateral value.

root_cause_evidence: Failure to clear the approval authorization for NFT resulted in authorized agents being able to transfer the NFT multiple times.
exploitation_evidence: The NFT authorization is not reset.
fix_strategy_evidence: Reset the approval on transfer.

root_cause_evidence: liensOpenForEpoch is not incremented when purchasing liens.
exploitation_evidence: When Public Vault A acquired lien tokens, liensOpenForEpoch was not calculated correctly, resulting in an overflow when repaying.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add a call to increaseEpochLienCount().

root_cause_evidence: The reward distribution for old pools is not updated when adding new token pools.
exploitation_evidence: Users are unable to accurately calculate the rewards they deserve.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call massUpdate() to refresh rewards for all existing pools before adding a new one.

root_cause_evidence: The user's latest debt status is not updated.
exploitation_evidence: Debt shares are miscalculated, which in turn causes subsequent liquidation operations to fail.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update the user's latest debt record in the _repay() function.

root_cause_evidence: pointsSum.slope is not updated when nominees are removed.
exploitation_evidence: Errors occurred in the calculation of voting weights, affecting the accuracy of the governance mechanism.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update pointsSum.slope in removeNominee()

root_cause_evidence: The liquidateClean function does not update the borrower's loan shares.
exploitation_evidence: The borrower's remaining share is not deducted from its actual debt.
fix_strategy_evidence: Include the remaining shares in _sharesToLiquidate after liquidation.

root_cause_evidence: The idleETH is decremented before LP token burning.
exploitation_evidence: The reward calculation is wrong, and the attacker calls the withdrawETH() function to steal ETH.
fix_strategy_evidence: Decrement idleETH only after token burning.

root_cause_evidence: When liquidate() performs clearing operations for multiple users, it uses the same minAssetAmount value and lacks variables for different records.
exploitation_evidence: The liquidation amount was inaccurate, resulting in losses to both the liquidator and the agreement.
fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the liquidate() function to enable liquidators to pass multiple minAssetAmount parameter values, so that each value corresponds to a different borrower.

root_cause_evidence: The accumulated interest rate is not updated during account liquidation.
exploitation_evidence: Interest calculation error, the borrower bypassed interest payment through self liquidation.
fix_strategy_evidence: Revise the previous accumulated interest rate update method.

root_cause_evidence: The previous getApproved[_tokenId] approval status is not revoked.
exploitation_evidence: Approval was not revoked after the NFT was transferred, and the previous owner transferred the NFT back to himself through repeated transactions.
fix_strategy_evidence: Clear the approval status after transferring the NFT.

root_cause_evidence: During delegate operations, the "Checkpoint memory oldCheckpoint" in the function is only modified in memory and not written to storage.
exploitation_evidence: The checkpoint is not written correctly, and the user's second delegation operation will not be persisted, resulting in the loss of delegation information.
fix_strategy_evidence: Change "memory oldCheckpoint" to "storage oldCheckpoint".

root_cause_evidence: The variable totalBurned is not updated.
exploitation_evidence: The amount received by the user during subsequent redemption is inaccurate, resulting in financial loss.
fix_strategy_evidence: After refunding refundedAmt, update totalBurned to deduct the refunded amount.

root_cause_evidence: lastFee is not updated in the handleFees function when totalSupply is zero.
exploitation_evidence: When the basket is replenished, the cost will be calculated based on the incorrect time difference.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update lastFee even when totalSupply is zero.

root_cause_evidence: A mapping for tracking whether a veto vote has been cast is missing.
exploitation_evidence: Users can vote down the same proposal multiple times, allowing users with a small number of votes to veto any proposal.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add a hasVoted map to track whether each (party, proposalId, address) triple has already cast a veto vote.

root_cause_evidence: The fee accumulator value is not synchronized with the pool's current state.
exploitation_evidence: Inaccurate values of fee increases were used to calculate fees over the period of borrowing, which resulted in borrowers paying additional fees at the time of repayment.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call collectLiquidity() to synchronize the fee accumulator.

root_cause_evidence: The key manager is not reset.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker repeats the transaction after the key transfer, either returning the key to themselves or transferring it to other recipients.
fix_strategy_evidence: Reset the key manager in the transferFrom function.

root_cause_evidence: ts.tokens == 0 causes ts.lastUpdate to remain unupdated.
exploitation_evidence: Ts.token was miscalculated, resulting in the extraction of more tokens than it should have been.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update ts.lastUpdate even when ts.tokens is zero.

root_cause_evidence: The reward records for this Flywheel are not removed simultaneously when removing the BribeFlywheel.
exploitation_evidence: It is not possible to add new Flywheel incentives that would affect the protocol functionality.
fix_strategy_evidence: Remove the reward token assets associated with the Flywheel.

root_cause_evidence: The data in _queueAccounting[lastQueueIndex] is not cleared when deploying a new withdrawal queue.
exploitation_evidence: queueClaimAll() used outdated data and incorrectly allocated the total amount due.
fix_strategy_evidence: Clear _queueAccounting[lastQueueIndex] data in deployWithdrawalQueue().

root_cause_evidence: Child node states are not considered when unwrapping the parent node.
exploitation_evidence: When unblocking child nodes, the original expiration time management mechanism was disrupted.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add proper constraints when setting child node expiration times and destroy the parent node's CANNOT_UNWRAP permission.

root_cause_evidence: updatedAt is not updated when creating proposals.
exploitation_evidence: The collateral ratio was calculated incorrectly and was lower than that recorded in other valid redemption proposals, thus successfully initiating an invalid dispute and obtaining penalty fees.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update updatedAt in the decreaseCollateral() function.

root_cause_evidence: The _updateRewardsPerToken function early returns when totalSupply is zero.
exploitation_evidence: When minting for the first time, the user mistakenly received all the rewards from the previous reward period.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update lastUpdated even when totalSupply is zero.

root_cause_evidence: The auctionBurn function does not update ibRatio when burning auction bonds.
exploitation_evidence: The calculation of total supply was incorrect, resulting in some assets being frozen.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update ibRatio based on the withdrawn amount in the auctionBurn function.

root_cause_evidence: Exception handling for the zero address (address(0)) and the contract's own address (address(this)) skips _cacheFees updates for these addresses.
exploitation_evidence: Exploiting faulty accounting logic to bypass proper fee accumulation when collectFees() is called and steal reserve assets.
fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the skip conditions and add overflow checks.

root_cause_evidence: The index in feederPositionMap is not updated when removing oracle addresses.
exploitation_evidence: A calculation error caused an out-of-bounds access error when deleting the feeder.
fix_strategy_evidence: Synchronize updates to oracle indexes moved to new positions in feederPositionMap during deletion.

root_cause_evidence: During generation switching, the current generation's counter genMintCount is reset, failing to accurately record the true minting quantity of the previous generation when the next generation begins.
exploitation_evidence: The number of new generations of entities was calculated incorrectly and allowed infinite generations of entities to be created.
fix_strategy_evidence: Remove the operation that resets genMintCount.

root_cause_evidence: Token balances are not promptly updated when the contract switches revenue sources.
exploitation_evidence: The calculation of balance and shares is incorrect, resulting in users receiving undeserved shares.
fix_strategy_evidence: Remove calls to the external functions transferFunds and setYieldSource, and restrict swapYieldSource to owner-only access.

root_cause_evidence: The total value locked (TVL) is not promptly updated when users deposit or withdraw.
exploitation_evidence: Wrong token share calculated using outdated TVL.
fix_strategy_evidence: First update the TVL, then proceed with other operations when depositing or withdrawing tokens.

root_cause_evidence: The ids[] array is not reordered to place new loans at the ids[0] position.
exploitation_evidence: Errors in recording new loans enabled borrowers to create loans that could not be liquidated.
fix_strategy_evidence: Reorder the ids array to update the new loan entry to ids[0].

root_cause_evidence: The endTime is incorrectly updated to block.timestamp in updateArtSettings().
exploitation_evidence: The attacker exploited the extended endTime to repeat the transaction and mint additional tokens.
fix_strategy_evidence: Separate the update logic for "uri", "soulBounded", and "royalty" config. Additionally, change the ">" to ">=" in the time validation condition.

root_cause_evidence: The NFT approval is not revoked.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker cancels the proposal in progress, thereby bypassing the protection measures and stealing the NFT.
fix_strategy_evidence: Clear the authorization after the proposal is canceled.

root_cause_evidence: The Lock.extendLock function increases the locked amount but does not update the total locked amount.
exploitation_evidence: An accounting error resulted in the inability to release locked assets added through the extendLock() function in the future.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update totalLocked[_asset] in Lock.extendLock.

root_cause_evidence: The performance fee is not deducted during liquidation.
exploitation_evidence: The fees deducted when closing a position were not distributed correctly, causing users to lose part of the token value when withdrawing.
fix_strategy_evidence: Deduct performanceFee from premiumCollected in getTokenPrice().

root_cause_evidence: Both _verifyUnsuccessfulState() and _verifySuccessfulState() functions return true for the terminationPeriod timestamp.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker stole funds by repeatedly claiming already refunded funds.
fix_strategy_evidence: Change the time comparison condition in the _verifySuccessfulState() function from "<" to "<=".

root_cause_evidence: The spend_limit is not decremented based on spent amounts.
exploitation_evidence: config.spend_limit was not reduced after each spend, causing all subsequent spends to bypass the limit and the attacker could call the spend function multiple times.
fix_strategy_evidence: After the spending operation is successful, reduce the value of config.spend_limit accordingly.

root_cause_evidence: The _shareMochi() function incorrectly resets treasuryShare.
exploitation_evidence: VeCRV holders can receive tokens that should have been allocated to treasure multiple times.
fix_strategy_evidence: Remove the operation that resets treasuryShare.

root_cause_evidence: The variable for accumulating and storing the remaining debt after each auction is lacking.
exploitation_evidence: The debt was not properly liquidated, resulting in the auction proceeds going directly to the borrower.
fix_strategy_evidence: Increase the record of the debt gap through the newly added _shortfall variable.

root_cause_evidence: The loan pool accounting records are not updated when lenders buy out loans via the settleWithBuyout() function.
exploitation_evidence: The accounting in the pool was not handled correctly, which affected the balance and profit distribution in the pool.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call loanLiquidation() within settleWithBuyout() to ensure accounting data updates.

root_cause_evidence: The old delegatee is not removed.
exploitation_evidence: The old delegators were not deleted, resulting in the same user being able to double-count voting rights by delegating the same token multiple times.
fix_strategy_evidence: remove the user's old delegation before executing a new operation.

root_cause_evidence: The remaining tokens are not refunded.
exploitation_evidence: Incorrect calculation and refund of remaining underlying tokens.
fix_strategy_evidence: Calculate and trade only the required token amount, then refund any remaining tokens to the user after the transaction.

root_cause_evidence: userTotalStaked is not updated when releasing funds.
exploitation_evidence: The actual pledge amount does not match userTotalStaked, thus miscalculating the withdrawn funds at the time of withdrawal.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update the userTotalStaked in release().

root_cause_evidence: The claimRewardAsMochi function does not reduce the user's reward balance.
exploitation_evidence: The referrer can repeatedly claim the same reward until the fee pool is exhausted.
fix_strategy_evidence: Decrement the user's reward balance in the claimRewardAsMochi function.

root_cause_evidence: The "amountOutMinimum" parameter is missing for slippage protection.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker can manipulate the transaction price through a front-running attack, causing the output amount of the swap to be lower than expected.
fix_strategy_evidence: Pass the correct amountOutMinimum value.

root_cause_evidence: When updating the voting proxy, both the old and new checkpoints were updated, causing the previous checkpoint to erroneously include the latest changes.
exploitation_evidence: Incorrect vote counting affects the integrity of the voting system.
fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the "storage checkpoint" to "memory checkpoint" in both the delegate() and removeDelegation() functions.

root_cause_evidence: The latest interest is not counted into the total assets.
exploitation_evidence: The next cycle cannot be started correctly and users' funds cannot be withdrawn.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call accrue() at the beginning of processEpoch() to account for the latest interest.

root_cause_evidence: The add_gauge() function does not initialize the time_weight value when adding a new gauge.
exploitation_evidence: Initial weights that are not set correctly can result in incorrect calculation of voting rights associated with gauges.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call change_gauge_weight() when adding a gauge, setting its initial weight to 0.

root_cause_evidence: The treasury fee is not deducted from the interest paid to lenders.
exploitation_evidence: The treasury fees receivable were not deducted from the interest due to the lenders, resulting in the loss of these fees.
fix_strategy_evidence: Accrue the earned interest to the interestAccrued mapping.

root_cause_evidence: The virtualRewards is not initialized when liquidity is first provided to the protocol.
exploitation_evidence: Ability to incorrectly claim all rewards in the pool due to lack of virtual reward deductions.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call performUpkeep() before the initial distribution of the contract to achieve initialization.

root_cause_evidence: The user's userGaugeProfitIndex is not properly initialized during the first call to claimGaugeRewards().
exploitation_evidence: Subsequent bias in the calculation of rewards allows the attacker to be rewarded directly.
fix_strategy_evidence: Check if userGaugeProfitIndex is 0, and if so, set it to the current gaugeProfitIndex.

root_cause_evidence: The stakedAt timestamp is not reinitialized when a user obtains non-revocable Prime tokens.
exploitation_evidence: Users repeatedly claim Prime token without pledging XVS.
fix_strategy_evidence: Reinitialize the stakedAt timestamp when issuing non-revocable Prime tokens.

root_cause_evidence: Lenders can replace the Oracle after loan approval.
exploitation_evidence: After the loan is issued, the attacker uses the updateLoanParams() function to maliciously replace the oracle.
fix_strategy_evidence: Add validation for params.oracle == cur.oracle in the checks.

root_cause_evidence: Decrement the ethAvailable before each contributeFor() call.
exploitation_evidence: When a contribution fails, the remaining ETH is not correctly calculated and refunded to the user, resulting in the user losing funds.
fix_strategy_evidence: Move the ethAvailable decrement operation after the contributeFor() call.

root_cause_evidence: The reclaimIncentive function does not decrement the incentive.rewardsUnclaimed field.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker repeatedly called the recaaimIncentive function to steal all tokens in the incentive pool.
fix_strategy_evidence: Decrement the incentive.rewardsUnclaimed field by the withdrawn amount.

root_cause_evidence: When the token is transferred from an invalid plot to a valid one, the user's "dirty" flag is not reinitialized.
exploitation_evidence: Reward calculation was skipped by mistake.
fix_strategy_evidence: Set the "dirty" flag when the user successfully transfers to a valid plot.

root_cause_evidence: There is a lack of variables for tracking the reward distribution of each point.
exploitation_evidence: The reward calculation did not correctly reflect the changes in the total points of the pool, affecting the user's rewards.
fix_strategy_evidence: Introduce the rewardPerTokenStored variable to track the reward distribution for each point.

root_cause_evidence: Collateral data is marked as removed on-chain but not actually withdrawn.
exploitation_evidence: The amount of collateral is reduced in storage but not deducted from the transaction, resulting in the loss of collateral.
fix_strategy_evidence: Call removeCollateral() to withdraw collateral while updating usedFunds.

root_cause_evidence: The granted NFT transaction authorization is not revoked.
exploitation_evidence: The authorization has not been revoked, and the authorized person can transfer NFTs repeatedly.
fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the status variables that control the granting or revocation of permissions.

root_cause_evidence: The update_emergency_council_7_D_0_C_1_C_58() function fails to correctly update the target state (i.e., the emergency_council address) and instead erroneously modifies another administrative role, nft_manager.
exploitation_evidence: An incorrect update to nft_manager caused emergency management to not work properly.
fix_strategy_evidence: Update the emergency_council address.

root_cause_evidence: The keroseneVault is not authorized to the KerosineManager.
exploitation_evidence: The attacker registers the same asset to both management systems at the same time, causing the asset to be counted twice.
fix_strategy_evidence: Manage keroseneVault and regular vault in separate mappings, used for price calculation and authorization management respectively.
